artifacts.summary: 8-phase, 10.5-hour plan correcting 28 over-reporting Constraints-consumed markers via binder-free twins plus delegating corollaries, closing on a full gate run.

memory_candidates.content: When a gate discharges a claim by DELEGATION (a declaration's corrected/narrowed docstring claim is accepted because its own code names a cleaner twin), the discharge is per-declaration, not per-dependency-chain: the delegate must be named in that declaration's own body, carry an identical claim, and itself be free of the construct being narrowed away. Enabler leverage up the call chain reduces the COST of writing each twin (the proof body is the original's with one substitution) but never the COUNT of twins needed. Sizing such work by counting enabler lemmas instead of counting gated declarations understates it by an order of magnitude. Concretely in this repo: check-module-invariants.sh C34a's delegates() predicate over 'Constraints consumed:' markers.
